import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

# exactly 2 MiB decoded data (16 datagrams x 16 packets x 64 frames x 2048 B)
def bigdata_exact():
    evs = []
    for d in range(16):
        pkts = [{"level":"I","pn":d*100+i,"auth":False,
                 "frames":[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"aa"*2048}]*64}
                for i in range(16)]
        evs.append({"t":d,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":pkts})
    return req([trace("a", evs)])

got = run(bigdata_exact())
check("2MiB-exact accepted", is_invalid(got), False)

# one more byte -> invalid
def bigdata_over():
    evs = bigdata_exact()["traces"][0]["events"]
    evs.append({"t":16,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,
                "packets":[{"level":"I","pn":999,"auth":False,
                            "frames":[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"aa"}]}]})
    return req([trace("a", evs)])
expect_invalid("2MiB+1", bigdata_over())

# exactly 60000 frames
evs = []
n = 0
while n < 60000:
    k = min(64, 60000-n)
    evs.append({"t":0,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,
                "packets":[{"level":"I","pn":i,"auth":False,"frames":[{"type":"PING"}]*k} for i in range(16)]})
    n += 16*k
got = run(req([trace("a", evs)]))
check("60000 frames accepted", is_invalid(got), False)

# 60001 frames -> invalid
evs.append({"t":1,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":[{"level":"I","pn":0,"auth":False,"frames":[{"type":"PING"}]}]})
expect_invalid("60001 frames", req([trace("a", evs)]))

# 20000 packets exactly (with 1 frame each)
pkts = [{"level":"I","pn":i,"auth":False,"frames":[{"type":"PING"}]} for i in range(16)]
evs = [{"t":0,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":pkts} for _ in range(1250)]
got = run(req([trace("a", evs)]))
check("20000 packets accepted", is_invalid(got), False)

# 20001 packets
evs.append({"t":1,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":[pkts[0]]})
expect_invalid("20001 packets", req([trace("a", evs)]))

# 32 traces, 20000 events
traces = []
for i in range(32):
    evs = [{"t":j,"op":"tick"} for j in range(625)]
    traces.append(trace("t%d"%i, evs))
got = run(req(traces))
check("32 traces/20000 events accepted", is_invalid(got), False)

# 33 traces / 20001 events
traces.append(trace("zz", []))
expect_invalid("33 traces", req(traces))

traces = [trace("a", [{"t":j,"op":"tick"} for j in range(20001)])]
expect_invalid("20001 events", req(traces))

# empty traces + empty events
got = run({"version":1,"traces":[]})
check("empty traces", got, {"version":1,"results":[]})
got = run(req([trace("a", [])]))
check("empty events", got["results"][0]["connection"],
      {"state":"open","code":None,"at_ms":None,"source":None,"peer_code":None,"last_activity_ms":0})

# deeply nested junk
deep = "[" * 5000 + "]" * 5000
expect_invalid("deep nested", '{"version":1,"traces":' + deep + '}')
deep2 = "{" * 3000 + "}" * 3000
expect_invalid("deep objects", deep2)

summary()
sys.exit(1 if FAIL else 0)
EOF
